test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first (1) and the last (6) sentences are in the correct order, the sentences in between (A-D) are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

1. During the colonial rule in India, Robert Bruce was the first who noticed tea plants growing near Rangpur in 1823.

A. The species was found to be similar to that grown in Chinese tea gardens.

B. By 1862, the Assam tea industry comprised around 160 gardens.

C. The leaves of the plants were examined and the consequence was something fruitful.

D. Mr. Maniram Dewan was the first Indian tea planter who established the commercial plantation that we know today as the Assam tea.

6.Today the region has grown to become one of the world's largest tea-producing belts.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct order of sentences is **C-A-D-B**.
 
• This order ensures a logical flow of information, starting from the examination of the tea leaves, to the identification of the species, the establishment of commercial plantations, and finally the growth of the Assam tea industry.
 
• The correct paragraph is:
 
 
• 1. During the colonial rule in India, Robert Bruce was the first who noticed tea plants growing near Rangpur in 1823.
 
• C. The leaves of the plants were examined and the consequence was something fruitful.
 
• A. The species was found to be similar to that grown in Chinese tea gardens.
 
• D. Mr. Maniram Dewan was the first Indian tea planter who established the commercial plantation that we know today as the Assam tea.
 
• B. By 1862, the Assam tea industry comprised around 160 gardens.
 
• 6. Today the region has grown to become one of the world's largest tea-producing belts.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** order is CADB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Understanding the** logical flow** of information is crucial in arranging sentences to form a coherent paragraph.
 
• Look for clues like **chronological order**, cause and effect, and introduction of new ideas to determine the correct sequence.
 
• Practicing with various **sentence arrangement** exercises can help improve this skill.
